dc: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Datos_conciliados_of WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' ORDER BY Fecha
ajuste: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_ajuste_camiones_emision_test WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' ORDER BY Fecha
cache: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.reporte_turno_cache_emision_test WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' ORDER BY Fecha,Turno
mov_srr: SELECT mov_id,Fecha,Turno,Origen,Solido,Fase,Banco,Pala,Destino,Ton,Poligono_CIO,CuTG00,Tonelaje_Hum_CIO,Tonelaje_seco_CIO,ID,Flota_CEX,N_BREAK,PONDCuTG00,PONDHumedad FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Fase)))='SRR' ORDER BY Fecha,Turno,mov_id
mov_powerbi_srr: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam_powerbi WHERE fecha >= '20260901' AND fecha < '20261001' AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(fase)))='SRR' ORDER BY fecha,turno,id
imp_srr: SELECT id,batch_id,imported_at,[date],[datetime],origen,shovel,[from],[to],dumpid,tonnage,cut,hum_estim,minty,minty_corto FROM DEV_SIIR.hidro.imp_csv WHERE [date] >= '20260901' AND [date] < '20261001' AND (UPPER(shovel)='SRR' OR UPPER([from]) LIKE '%SRR%' OR UPPER([to]) LIKE '%SRR%') ORDER BY [date],id
imp_batches: SELECT batch_id,origen,shovel,[to],COUNT(*) AS n,MIN(imported_at) AS imported_min,MAX(imported_at) AS imported_max,MIN([date]) AS fecha_min,MAX([date]) AS fecha_max,SUM(tonnage) AS tonnage FROM DEV_SIIR.hidro.imp_csv WHERE [date] >= '20260901' AND [date] < '20261001' GROUP BY batch_id,origen,shovel,[to]
srr_origen: SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_srr_tms_origen_turno_emision_test WHERE Fecha >= '20260901' AND Fecha < '20261001' ORDER BY Fecha,Turno
dependencies: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(referencing_id) AS esquema,OBJECT_NAME(referencing_id) AS objeto,referenced_database_name,referenced_schema_name,referenced_entity_name,referenced_minor_id FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies WHERE referenced_entity_name LIKE '%conciliado%' OR referenced_entity_name LIKE '%mov_cam%' OR referenced_entity_name LIKE '%imp_csv%'
